about_the_game:
GIT GUD! GIT BETTER! GIT SERIOUS!

SERIOUS SURVIVORS is a brutally intense roguelike FPS where over-the-top carnage meets ridiculous power-ups. Circle-strafe, jump, dodge backpedal, and blast your way through endless hordes of enemies while collecting absurd perks that transform you from "zero" to "super-bad-ass-hero".

Hell is empty, and all the monsters are here – waiting for you to fill them with lead.

MONSTERS GO "RAWR"

Clash with waves and waves of bloodthirsty enemies. From mildly annoying bastards to semi-deities eating heroes like you for breakfast. Every run throws hundreds of foes at you simultaneously. The only escape is through a mountain of corpses.

GUNS GO "PEW-PEW-PEW"

Start with a trusty pistol, end with a walking arsenal of destruction. Dual-wield shotguns, unleash minigun mayhem, or reduce enemies to bloody mist with the particle disintegrator. Unlock new weapons between runs to expand your options for the next slaughter.

UPGRADES GO "BRRR"

Combine during a single run for earth-shattering builds. Double your rate of fire! Triple your movement speed! Bullets that explode into more bullets! Create combos so powerful they should be illegal (and probably are in some dimensions).

UNLOCKS GO "OH YEAH"

Death is just the beginning. Use resources collected during runs to permanently unlock new starting weapons, perk options, and chaotic environments. Every failure brings you one step closer to becoming an unstoppable killing machine.

ONE MORE RUN!

Just died after a 20-minute rampage? Don't worry, the next run is just seconds away. Quick restarts and addictive gameplay loops will keep you saying "just one more" until the sun comes up. Your sleep schedule never stood a chance.

content_descriptors.notes: Unrealistic creatures blood and gore killing

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: windows 10 64bit or later
  • Processor: Quad Core 2.4 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 470 / AMD Radeon 6870 HD
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: windows 10 64bit or later
  • Processor: Quad Core 3.0 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: The most EXPLOSIVE roguelike boomer shooter. Fully packed with serious action, wicked humor, and good old bloody fun. Blast hordes of bastards, stack insane perks, and unlock new stuff. Survive…or get shredded trying!.. And try again.
